currentParagraphText: “If you desire an easily regenerated appendage, fine, but I did not agree to the bet yet, so this is me doing you a favor,” the Unique Lifeform said.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “If you desire an easily regenerated appendage, fine, but I did not agree to the bet yet, so this is me doing you a favor,” the Unique Lifeform said.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: The Seeker looked at the arm for a moment and then back at the King. “Sure. If you ever become a god, let’s just agree I owe you a small favor.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Jasper, the lovable little fella, looked confused at all the people staring at him, and it didn’t help matters when the Seeker suddenly proclaimed his desire for the Forest King to hand over his left arm. Things got worse yet again when the King responded by waving his right hand, tearing the arm off at the shoulder, and making it float toward the god.
